The upsets are — of the — games: — wins by a lower seed four or more lines down, and all — wide-gap games. Ahead at halftime, it won — of the time; six or more down at halftime, —.

Upsets and the line

The same upsets, set against the Las Vegas closing spread. The line is the lower seed’s: +6.5 means it was getting 6.5 points. In — of — upsets the lower seed was the betting underdog, by a median of — points. In — it was favored or a pick’em, so the market did not see an upset coming.
